Our core USP

Technology that makes trust verifiable

Other platforms ask you to believe them. NestPass lets you check, using four technologies working together.

⛓

Blockchain trust layer

Listing scans, ownership checks, landlord track records, tenancy agreements and move-in baselines are fingerprinted with SHA-256 and anchored on-chain, so history cannot be quietly edited or deleted.

  • Tamper-proof landlord and tenant history
  • Verifiable listing and Land Registry match
  • Immutable move-in baseline for fair deposits
🤖

AI that does real work

AI screens every listing for scams, reads identity and admission documents, compares move-in and move-out photos, and drafts first messages so renters and landlords connect faster.

  • Scam Shield: price, photo and contact forensics
  • Document AI: offer letters and visas into a Day-1 score
  • Computer vision: wear and tear vs damage
🔐

Security and privacy by design

Personal documents never go on-chain. Renters choose what they share, with whom, and when access ends. Chat guard blocks off-platform payment tricks before money moves.

  • Hash-only anchoring, encrypted documents
  • Permissioned sharing you can revoke
  • In-app chat guard against payment scams
🥽

Immersive VR tours

Walk through every room before you travel or sign. Each tour is tied to a GPS-stamped, hashed camera scan, so what you see is what the landlord actually captured.

  • Room-by-room 360° viewing
  • Scan fingerprint verified on-chain
  • No more bait-and-switch photos

Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about getting started with NestPass.

Only fingerprints (SHA-256 hashes) of records: a listing’s camera scan, a landlord’s deposit-return history, a signed tenancy agreement or a move-in baseline. Your passport scans, IDs and photos stay encrypted off-chain. If anyone changes a record later, its fingerprint no longer matches. Prototype note: anchoring is simulated in this demo; the production design uses hash-only anchoring on a public chain.
Scam Shield AI compares rent with neighbourhood medians and checks photos and phone numbers. Document AI reads your offer letter and visa to build a Day-1 trust score. Computer vision separates normal wear from damage at move-out. A message assistant also drafts a first note to the owner that you can edit before sending.
If you have never rented locally before, NestPass Document AI validates your university admission letter, student visa and hall notices. This unlocks a high starter Trust score on Day 1, so landlords can see you are a genuine student.
Instead of static photos that could be stolen or edited, landlords record an in-app camera walkthrough. The device signs it with GPS coordinates and a timestamp, computes a SHA-256 fingerprint and links it to the Land Registry ownership check. Tenants then explore the home room by room in VR.
Yes. Documents are encrypted and never published on-chain. You choose which landlord sees your passport and for how long, and you can revoke access at any time. In-app chat also warns you if someone asks you to pay or move to another app first.
Tenants with a high trust score and verified university credentials can qualify for a reduced or waived cash deposit (0–1 month instead of the usual 2). Landlords get risk assurance through verified, tamper-proof records.
At move-in, photos are hashed into an immutable baseline. At move-out, handover photos are compared with computer vision, separating normal daily wear from tenant-caused damage so deposit refunds are objective.

🔒 Before you start a call

Please take care. Calls are more personal than messages.

  • Protect your details. Never share ID or passport numbers, bank or card details, passwords or one-time codes on a call.
  • No payments or signing on a call. Anyone asking you to pay, transfer a deposit or sign first is a common scam. Keep payments and documents inside NestPass.
  • Mind what can be seen and heard. Check your background and surroundings, especially on video: letters, documents, screens and your address.
  • Do not record or screenshot the other person without their clear consent.
  • Feel unsafe or pressured? End the call straight away and report the user.
